name: @omarchy/harness
description: Packaging pin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) runtime this overlay boots. node_modules is a packaging-time artifact (npm ci at build time into /usr/lib/omarchy-harness/), never committed; see plans/harness.md. Deliberately no "type" field: host.js and lib/*.js are CommonJS, unlike the dsh-omarchy bundle in bundle/dsh-omarchy/, which carries its own "type": "module".
